response.overview: Everyone loves spending an evening by a campfire. Hearing the rustle of leaves and feeling the crackling warmth on your hands as it shields you from the cold; listening to a familiar song, sharing an old story.   But as the hours slip by and the surrounding forest seems to grow ever more vast; when the fire no longer lights up faces and conversations twist into strange gestures, you might want to flee, while there is still time.
response.title: FIRESIDE
